name: Stat Card
description: KPI tile with label, value, optional unit, trend delta and icon. Renders one card (partial) or a responsive grid of cards (report).
helpText: Displays a key figure with an optional trend indicator. Map Trend to a column returning up, down or flat. Colors follow the active Universal Theme style (including dark styles and Theme Roller changes).

attributes.name: Label
attributes.helpText: Short caption shown above the value, for example Open Orders.

attributes.name: Value
attributes.helpText: The key figure. Format it in SQL (for example to_char(amount, 'FML999G999G990')) so it follows the application's NLS settings.

attributes.name: Unit
attributes.helpText: Optional unit rendered after the value, for example %, SAR or ms.

attributes.name: Change
attributes.helpText: Optional delta text such as +12.4%. Leave empty to hide the trend row.

attributes.name: Trend
attributes.helpText: Direction of the change: up, down or flat. Any other value renders as flat.

attributes.name: Down Is Good
attributes.helpText: Swap trend colors so a decrease is shown as positive, for example for costs or error rates.

attributes.name: Icon
attributes.helpText: Font APEX icon class, for example fa-users. Can be static text or a column.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.helpText: Optional footnote, for example vs. last month.

attributes.name: Accent
attributes.helpText: Colors the icon and top edge using the theme palette.

attributes.name: Columns
attributes.helpText: Report mode only. Auto fits as many cards as the region width allows; the fixed options collapse to one column on phones.
